_note: Customer reviews carried over from the previous website. Confirmed by the owner (Oct 2026) as genuine customers who agreed to be quoted. Add new reviews only with the customer's permission. Do not add star ratings unless they come from a verifiable review platform.

reviews.name: Wanjiku Njeri
reviews.text: Cleantique Solutions did a deep clean for our 2-bedroom apartment and the results were incredible. The bathrooms and kitchen looked brand new. Very professional and punctual.

reviews.name: Faith Achieng
reviews.text: Our office needed a reliable cleaning partner and Cleantique has delivered consistently. Their team is organized, discreet, and the quality is always top-notch.

reviews.name: Denis Kariuki
reviews.text: We booked a move-out cleaning and it was worth every shilling. The place was spotless and the agent was impressed during inspection. Smooth experience from booking to finish.

reviews.name: Sharon Cherono
reviews.text: We had a serious cockroach issue and Cleantique handled it professionally. They explained everything clearly, used safe products, and we saw results immediately.

reviews.name: Kevin Mutuku
reviews.text: Our sofa had stains and a smell we couldn't remove. Cleantique cleaned it thoroughly and it looks and smells fresh again. Excellent service.

reviews.name: Mark Mutua
reviews.text: As an Airbnb host, cleanliness is everything. Cleantique is reliable, fast, and the place is always guest-ready. My reviews have improved because of them.

reviews.name: Paul Ndung'u
reviews.text: We did the deep cleaning and fumigation combo and the value was amazing. The house felt fresh, sanitized, and pest-free. I highly recommend Cleantique Solutions.

reviews.name: Peter Kibet
reviews.text: Cleantique handled our bed bug problem with so much professionalism. They gave us preparation instructions, treated the house thoroughly, and followed up. Very trustworthy team.

reviews.name: Lucy Osoro
reviews.text: We've been using Cleantique for weekly cleaning and it's been such a relief. The team is respectful, fast, and detailed. Our home stays fresh without stress.
